objective: Verify BSP image input digests instead of accepting any 64-hex string, so a manifest cannot claim inputs_locked without the artifact being hashed.
acceptance: a local input declaring a digest is hashed and compared, and a mismatch names the field with expected and actual value
missing, truncated, unreadable, directory and path-escaping local inputs fail closed
network inputs and the container digest require a retrieval record of url, size_bytes and sha256, with HTTPS URLs and a digest-pinned registry reference
an output digest is NOT_BUILT or bound to a build_record whose artifacts are hashed
inputs_locked is unreachable while any error exists
the committed manifest stays non-buildable and explicitly inputs_unresolved
evidence: the audit reproduction with all-zero digests now returns 15 errors naming every unverified digest
stop_conditions: a digest would have to be invented or fetched to satisfy validation
the change would require downloading a vendor artifact
a schema under interfaces/ would have to change
